name: Sheraton Mall of the Emirates Hotel, Dubai
positioning: City hotel on Sheikh Zayed Road with direct access to Mall of the Emirates, rooftop pools and a 24th-floor spa
best_for: Shoppers and families who want a direct connection to Mall of the Emirates and Ski Dubai
Business travelers who want Club Lounge access and Metro connections

facts.text: Mall of the Emirates features about 630 brands.
Two rooftop pools offer views of the city skyline.
The gym has cardio and strength equipment, a sauna and a steam room.
Rooms and suites have views of downtown Dubai and Jumeirah Beach.
Rooms offer Gilchrist & Soames amenities, 24-hour room service, bottled water and a minibar.
Club rooms are on higher floors with Dubai skyline views and include access to the Sheraton Club Lounge.
The Sheraton Club Lounge offers complimentary breakfast, all-day snacks and beverages, business center services and free high-speed Wi-Fi.
The Amiri Suite has a living room, dining area, fully equipped kitchen, Nespresso machine and washing machine, with Dubai skyline views.
Families can choose spacious layouts and interconnecting rooms.
The 3 Bedroom Family Suite sleeps up to 7.
Besh Turkish Kitchen, on the fifth floor, serves Turkish cuisine with a contemporary twist.

highlights.text: The hotel has direct access to Mall of the Emirates, Metro connections and a Sheikh Zayed Road address.
The rooftop pools look out on the Downtown skyline with Burj Khalifa and over to Burj Al Arab.
The spa is on the 24th floor, with city views, treatment rooms and facial and body therapies.
Mall of the Emirates has attractions such as VOX Cinemas and Ski Dubai.
Shoppers can drop bags at the mall collection desks and have them delivered to their room free of charge.

considerations.text: Breakfast at Besh Turkish Kitchen and &More by Sheraton is available for a fee.
WhataHotel notes the shopping mall location may feel busy for those seeking tranquility.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is a distance from Dubai's historic districts and traditional attractions.
